gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Transfers In: General 738,600 + Sales Tax 19,092 = 757,692. Detail records the General Fund combining schedule pp11-12 gross by sub-fund: department transfers in 237,531 + 49,305 + 445,117 + 61,988 + 306,115 + 77,639 + 98,075 = 1,275,770 and General department Transfers Out (537,170), which the schedule's Eliminations column removes (1,275,770 - 537,170 = 738,600 = the statement's General column). Difference 757,692 - 1,294,862 = -537,170 = exactly the printed intra-General-Fund transfers. Both as printed; no fix.

Statement p5 Transfers Out: Streets and Alley (19,092) + Sales Tax (900,000) = 919,092. Detail adds the General Fund combining schedule's intra-fund Transfers Out (537,170) (General department, p12), which the statement nets inside the General column (738,600 net in). 919,092 - 1,456,262 = -537,170 = that printed amount. As printed; no fix.
